column1: # Phase 28 carried-red ledger. Authoritative machine form of 28-01-CERTIFICATION-CONTRACT.md section 7.
# inherited_severity is PROVENANCE ONLY and is never read by a gate (amendment A1).
# A contradicted_criterion other than "-" closes the ACCEPTED and DEFERRED paths (amendment A2),
# regardless of the severity recorded on the row.
# "-" means "none"; a genuinely empty field is rejected, so an omission cannot read as a none.
# disposition OPEN is legal here: plan 28-01 does not dispose findings; plan 28-04 does.

column2: descendant process tree is not reaped; a process survives its owner (wcore-sandbox::live_integrity::live_future_drop_reaps_descendant_job_tree, Windows, deterministic)
column8: A1 re-score: subject matter is an orphaned process. Criterion 2 subject matter is that the soak completes with no orphan process. Same subject, so A2 applies by construction and the accept path is closed. Panel calibration example 1.

column2: Windows snapshot private DACL enforcement is unproven; snapshot.rs windows_private_dacl_accepts_restrictive_deny_ace and ..._rejects_null_empty_and_broad_allow fail at their WRITE_DAC reopen step with error 5, identically at parent
column8: A1 re-score: the observed red is in the test's own reopen step and reproduces at parent, so it is not evidence of a candidate regression. Contradicts no criterion as scored. See contract section 3.4: the unproven-control corollary would move this across the A2 line and was deliberately not applied; the underlying property is forced into the open instead as a plan 28-02 matrix cell under the positive-evidence rule.

column8: A1 re-score: the red is a budget overrun in the test, not an observed retention of buffers, so no criterion-contradicting behaviour is established. See contract section 3.4. The underlying bound is a plan 28-02 matrix cell under the positive-evidence rule; where the measured cell and this row disagree the cell governs.

column2: bash cannot run under Windows AppContainer at all; msys requires \BaseNamedObjects and AppContainer confines to AppContainerNamedObjects by construction (0xC0000022)
column8: A1 re-score: architectural impossibility, not a defect in the candidate. The product contract is fail-closed and the test asserts it. This is the canonical architectural-impossibility skip instance and its impossibility_check is that fail-closed assertion.
